summary: Shortcut tile with icon, label and optional description, for quick-action grids in admin panels. It is a real <a href> or a <button>.
whenToUse: Grids of shortcuts to the most used sections (users, API keys, settings).
Frequent in-place actions (export, sync) with onPress.
whenNotToUse: Main portal navigation: use NavList or Sidebar.
Secondary actions in a toolbar: use Button or IconButton.
Rich content with multiple links: use Card.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label; together with the description it forms the accessible name.

props.name: badge
props.description: Trailing element, e.g. a Badge with a count (included in the accessible name).

props.name: href
props.description: When present, renders an <a href> (React Aria Link props: target, rel, routerOptions…).

props.name: onPress
props.description: Without href, renders a <button> (React Aria Button props).

props.name: layout
props.description: Icon above (tile) or beside (row) the text.

inherits: All react-aria-components Link (with href) or Button (without href) props and global DOM attributes.

keyboard.action: Follows the link or activates the button.

accessibility: Native <a href> or <button> element: no clickable div.
Place multiple tiles in a list (<ul>/<li>) so screen readers announce how many there are.
Minimum 44px target; visible focus ring and system border in forced-colors mode; the disabled state uses GrayText.
responsive: Fills its cell: use Grid with minItemWidth for grids that adapt without breakpoints.
commonMistakes: Using onPress with window.location to navigate: pass href.
Long labels: the tile is a shortcut, so the description should stay short.
limits: Has no pending state: disable the tile and update the description during the action, announcing the outcome with a live region.
